   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "def _lagger(x,y):\n",
    "    correlations = {}\n",
    "    for lag in range(0, 12 + 1):\n",
    "        x_lagged = x.shift(lag)\n",
    "        corr = x_lagged.corr(y)\n",
    "        correlations[lag] = corr\n",
    "        print(rf'Lag: {lag} Months, Correlation: {corr}')\n",
    "    return pd.Series(correlations, name=f'Corr(X_lag, Y)')\n",
    "\n",
    "def _regress(df_reg):\n",
    "\n",
    "    dep_var = df_reg.columns[0]\n",
    "    indep_vars = df_reg.columns[1:]\n",
    "\n",
    "    mean_dep = df_reg[dep_var].mean()\n",
    "    std_dep = df_reg[dep_var].std()\n",
    "    # mean_dep = 0.0029\n",
    "    # std_dep =  0.029 \n",
    "    \n",
    "    mean_indep = df_reg[indep_vars].mean()\n",
    "    std_indep = df_reg[indep_vars].std()    \n",
    "    #mean_indep = np.array([ 0.002194, 0.001255])\n",
    "    # std_indep = np.array([0.022, 0.023])\n",
    "\n",
    "    #print('mean: ', mean_dep, mean_indep)\n",
    "    #print('std: ', std_dep, std_indep)\n",
    "    # Calculate slope (m) and intercept (b) for milk and sugar\n",
    "    \n",
    "    m_indep = std_dep / std_indep # ratio of stds dependent/independent \n",
    "    b_indep = mean_dep - m_indep * mean_indep\n",
    "\n",
    "    # print('std: ', std_dep, std_indep)\n",
    "    # print('mean: ', mean_dep, mean_indep)\n",
    "    # print('mb: ', m_indep, b_indep)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Get the latest values of milk and sugar\n",
    "    \n",
    "    latest_indep = df_reg[indep_vars].iloc[-1]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # # Predict ice using the regression formula\n",
    "    _predicted_dep = m_indep * latest_indep + b_indep\n",
    "    \n",
    "    corr = [df_reg[dep_var].corr(df_reg[i]) for i in indep_vars]\n",
    "    \n",
    "\n",
    "    # Average the predictions from milk and sugar\n",
    "    _predicted_dep_avg = _predicted_dep.mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # _predicted_dep_avg = [c*_predicted_dep[i] for i,c in enumerate(corr)]\n",
    "    # _predicted_dep_avg = sum(_predicted_dep_avg)/sum(corr)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # print('predicted: ', predicted_dep)\n",
    "    # print('predicted avg: ', predicted_dep_avg)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return _predicted_dep_avg\n",
    "\n",
    "# START\n",
    "\n",
    "df_ice = pd.read_csv('icecream.csv')\n",
    "df_milk = pd.read_csv('milk.csv')\n",
    "df_sugar = pd.read_csv('sugar.csv')\n",
    "\n",
    "df_ice.rename(columns = {df_ice.columns[1]:'ice'}, inplace=True)\n",
    "df_milk.rename(columns = {df_milk.columns[1]:'milk'}, inplace=True)\n",
    "df_sugar.rename(columns = {df_sugar.columns[1]:'sugar'}, inplace=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "df_ice['observation_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_ice['observation_date'])\n",
    "df_milk['observation_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_milk['observation_date'])\n",
    "df_sugar['observation_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_sugar['observation_date'])\n",
    "\n",
    "df_ice = df_ice.set_index('observation_date')\n",
    "df_milk = df_milk.set_index('observation_date')\n",
    "df_sugar = df_sugar.set_index('observation_date')\n",
    "\n",
    "# MoM\n",
    "df_ice['ice'] = df_ice['ice'].pct_change()*100\n",
    "df_milk['milk'] = df_milk['milk'].pct_change()*100\n",
    "df_sugar['sugar'] = df_sugar['sugar'].pct_change()*100\n",
    "# 4 9 10 12\n",
    "df_milk.index = df_milk.index.shift(1, freq='MS')\n",
    "df_milk['milk_l4'] = df_milk['milk'].shift(3)\n",
    "df_milk['milk_l9'] = df_milk['milk'].shift(8)\n",
    "df_milk['milk_l10'] = df_milk['milk'].shift(9)\n",
    "df_milk['milk_l12'] = df_milk['milk'].shift(12)\n",
    "# df_milk['milk_r2m'] = df_milk['milk'].rolling(window=6).mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1 5 7\n",
    "df_sugar.index = df_sugar.index.shift(1, freq='MS')\n",
    "df_sugar['sugar_l1'] = df_sugar['sugar']\n",
    "df_sugar['sugar_l5'] = df_sugar['sugar'].shift(4)\n",
    "df_sugar['sugar_l7'] = df_sugar['sugar'].shift(6)\n",
    "\n",
    "# df_sugar['sugar_r2m'] = df_sugar['sugar'].rolling(window=6).mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.merge(df_ice,df_milk,on='observation_date', how='outer')\n",
    "df = pd.merge(df,df_sugar,on='observation_date', how='outer')\n",
    "\n",
    "df = df[['ice','milk_l4','sugar_l1']]\n",
    "\n",
    "#print('ice-milk-lag')\n",
    "#_lagger(df['ice'],df['milk'])\n",
    "#print('ice-sugar-lag')\n",
    "#_lagger(df['ice'],df['sugar'])\n",
    "\n",
    "backtest_results = []\n",
    "\n",
    "start_date = df.index.min() # Start with the first two years of data\n",
    "end_date = start_date + pd.DateOffset(years=2)\n",
    "\n",
    "while end_date <= df.index.max():\n",
    "    # Create a subset of the data for the current window\n",
    "    df_window = df.loc[start_date:end_date].copy()\n",
    "    actual_dep =  df_window.loc[df_window.index.max(), 'ice']\n",
    "    df_window.loc[df_window.index.max(), 'ice'] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "    predicted_dep = _regress(df_window)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Store the results\n",
    "    backtest_results.append({\n",
    "        'end_date': end_date,\n",
    "        'predicted_ice': predicted_dep,\n",
    "        'actual_ice': actual_dep,\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Move the window forward by one month\n",
    "    end_date += pd.DateOffset(months=1)\n",
    "    #start_date += pd.DateOffset(months=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert results to a DataFrame for analysis\n",
    "backtest_df = pd.DataFrame(backtest_results)\n",
    "backtest_df['end_date'] = pd.to_datetime(backtest_df['end_date'])\n",
    "backtest_df.set_index('end_date', inplace=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "backtest_df = backtest_df[backtest_df.index >= pd.to_datetime('2022-01-01')]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.plot(backtest_df.index, backtest_df['predicted_ice'], label='Predicted Ice Cream Sales')\n",
    "plt.plot(backtest_df.index, backtest_df['actual_ice'], label='Actual Ice Cream Sales')\n",
    "plt.xlim(pd.to_datetime('2024-01-01'), backtest_df.index.max())\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "correlation = backtest_df['actual_ice'].corr(backtest_df['predicted_ice'])\n",
    "# Calculate R-squared\n",
    "rsq = correlation ** 2\n",
    "# Determine directionality\n",
    "directionality = ((backtest_df['actual_ice'] * backtest_df['predicted_ice']) > 0).mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Correlation: {correlation}\")\n",
    "print(f\"R-squared: {rsq}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Directionality: {directionality}\")\n",
    "print(backtest_df[-24:])"
   ]
  },

    "def ols_regression(df_reg):\n",
    "    # Ensure there are at least two columns (dependent and independent variables)\n",
    "    if df_reg.shape[1] < 2:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(\"DataFrame must have at least one dependent and one independent variable.\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Define dependent and independent variables\n",
    "    dep_var = df_reg.columns[0]\n",
    "    indep_vars = df_reg.columns[1:]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Drop rows with NaN values\n",
    "    df_reg = df_reg.dropna()\n",
    "    if len(df_reg) < 1:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add a constant for the intercept\n",
    "    X = sm.add_constant(df_reg[indep_vars])\n",
    "    y = df_reg[dep_var]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Ensure X and y are numeric\n",
    "    X = X.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')\n",
    "    y = pd.to_numeric(y, errors='coerce')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Drop rows with NaN values after conversion\n",
    "    X = X.dropna()\n",
    "    y = y.loc[X.index]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Fit the OLS model\n",
    "    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "    residuals = model.resid\n",
    "    squared_resid = residuals**2\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Regress squared residuals on predictors\n",
    "    X_var = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "    var_model = sm.OLS(squared_resid, X_var).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Predict variance estimates\n",
    "    predicted_var = var_model.predict(X_var)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Avoid division by zero or negative variances\n",
    "    predicted_var = np.clip(predicted_var, 1e-5, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Inverse-variance weights\n",
    "    weights = 1 / predicted_var\n",
    "\n",
    "    model = sm.WLS(y, X, weights=weights).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Predict the dependent variable for the last row of independent variables\n",
    "    last_row = X.iloc[-1]\n",
    "    predicted_value = model.predict(last_row)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return predicted_value.iloc[0]"
   ]

    "def wls_regression(df_reg):\n",
    "    # Ensure there are at least two columns (dependent and independent variables)\n",
    "    if df_reg.shape[1] < 2:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(\"DataFrame must have at least one dependent and one independent variable.\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Define dependent and independent variables\n",
    "    dep_var = df_reg.columns[0]\n",
    "    indep_vars = df_reg.columns[1:]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Drop rows with NaN values\n",
    "    df_reg = df_reg.dropna()\n",
    "    if len(df_reg) < 1:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add a constant for the intercept\n",
    "    X = sm.add_constant(df_reg[indep_vars])\n",
    "    y = df_reg[dep_var]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Define weights (example: inverse of variance)\n",
    "    weights = 1 / (df_reg[indep_vars].var(axis=0) + 1e-6)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Fit the WLS model\n",
    "    model = sm.WLS(y, X, weights=weights).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Predict the dependent variable for the last row of independent variables\n",
    "    last_row = X.iloc[-1]\n",
    "    predicted_value = model.predict(last_row)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return predicted_value.iloc[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Example usage\n",
    "predicted_dep = wls_regression(df_window)\n",
    "print(f\"Predicted value using WLS: {predicted_dep}\")"
   ]

    "# Normalize the 'ice' column\n",
    "df['ice_'] = (df['ice'] - df['ice'].min()) / (df['ice'].max() - df['ice'].min())\n",
    "df['milk_'] = (df['milk'] - df['milk'].min()) / (df['milk'].max() - df['milk'].min())\n",
    "df['sugar_'] = (df['sugar'] - df['sugar'].min()) / (df['sugar'].max() - df['sugar'].min())\n",
    "# Plot the normalized 'ice' values\n",
    "plt.plot(np.log10(df['ice_']), '-')\n",
    "plt.plot(np.log10(df['milk_']), '-')\n",
    "plt.plot(np.log10(df['sugar_']), '-')\n",
    "plt.legend(['ice', 'milk', 'sugar'])\n"
   ]

    "# ice = w1 * milk + w2 * sugar + e"
   ]

   "source": [
    "# Calculate mean and std for dependent and independent variables\n",
    "mean_ice = df['ice'].mean()\n",
    "std_ice = df['ice'].std()\n",
    "\n",
    "mean_milk = df['milk'].mean()\n",
    "std_milk = df['milk'].std()\n",
    "\n",
    "mean_sugar = df['sugar'].mean()\n",
    "std_sugar = df['sugar'].std()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate slope (m) and intercept (b) for milk and sugar\n",
    "m_milk = std_ice / std_milk # ratio of stds dependent/independent \n",
    "b_milk = mean_ice - m_milk * mean_milk\n",
    "\n",
    "m_sugar = std_ice / std_sugar\n",
    "b_sugar = mean_ice - m_sugar * mean_sugar\n",
    "\n",
    "# Get the latest values of milk and sugar\n",
    "latest_milk = df['milk'].iloc[-1]\n",
    "latest_sugar = df['sugar'].iloc[-1]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Predict ice using the regression formula\n",
    "predicted_ice_milk = m_milk * latest_milk + b_milk\n",
    "predicted_ice_sugar = m_sugar * latest_sugar + b_sugar\n",
    "\n",
    "# Average the predictions from milk and sugar\n",
    "predicted_ice = (predicted_ice_milk + predicted_ice_sugar) / 2"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# Calculate correlations\n",
    "ice_milk_corr = df['ice'].corr(df['milk'])\n",
    "ice_sugar_corr = df['ice'].corr(df['sugar'])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Normalize correlations to use as weights\n",
    "total_corr = ice_milk_corr + ice_sugar_corr\n",
    "weight_milk = ice_milk_corr / total_corr\n",
    "weight_sugar = ice_sugar_corr / total_corr\n",
    "\n",
    "print(weight_milk, weight_sugar)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Weighted average of predictions\n",
    "predicted_ice_weighted = (predicted_ice_milk * weight_milk) + (predicted_ice_sugar * weight_sugar)\n",
    "\n",
    "predicted_ice_weighted"
   ]

   "source": [
    "# Initialize variables to store results\n",
    "backtest_results = []\n",
    "\n",
    "# Start with the first two years of data\n",
    "start_date = df.index.min()\n",
    "end_date = start_date + pd.DateOffset(years=2)\n",
    "\n",
    "while end_date <= df.index.max():\n",
    "    # Create a subset of the data for the current window\n",
    "    df_window = df.loc[start_date:end_date]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Skip if there is insufficient data\n",
    "    if df_window['milk'].dropna().empty or df_window['sugar'].dropna().empty:\n",
    "        end_date += pd.DateOffset(months=1)\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calculate mean and std for dependent and independent variables\n",
    "    mean_ice = df_window['ice'].mean()\n",
    "    std_ice = df_window['ice'].std()\n",
    "\n",
    "    mean_milk = df_window['milk'].mean()\n",
    "    std_milk = df_window['milk'].std()\n",
    "\n",
    "    mean_sugar = df_window['sugar'].mean()\n",
    "    std_sugar = df_window['sugar'].std()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calculate slope (m) and intercept (b) for milk and sugar\n",
    "    m_milk = std_ice / std_milk\n",
    "    b_milk = mean_ice - m_milk * mean_milk\n",
    "\n",
    "    m_sugar = std_ice / std_sugar\n",
    "    b_sugar = mean_ice - m_sugar * mean_sugar\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Get the latest values of milk and sugar in the window\n",
    "    latest_milk = df_window['milk'].iloc[-1]\n",
    "    latest_sugar = df_window['sugar'].iloc[-1]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Predict ice using the regression formula\n",
    "    predicted_ice_milk = m_milk * latest_milk + b_milk\n",
    "    predicted_ice_sugar = m_sugar * latest_sugar + b_sugar\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Average the predictions from milk and sugar\n",
    "    predicted_ice = (predicted_ice_milk + predicted_ice_sugar) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calculate correlations\n",
    "    ice_milk_corr = df_window['ice'].corr(df_window['milk'])\n",
    "    ice_sugar_corr = df_window['ice'].corr(df_window['sugar'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Normalize correlations to use as weights\n",
    "    total_corr = ice_milk_corr + ice_sugar_corr\n",
    "    weight_milk = ice_milk_corr / total_corr\n",
    "    weight_sugar = ice_sugar_corr / total_corr\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Weighted average of predictions\n",
    "    predicted_ice_weighted = (predicted_ice_milk * weight_milk) + (predicted_ice_sugar * weight_sugar)\n",
    "    predicted_ice_weighted = (predicted_ice_milk + predicted_ice_sugar)/2\n",
    "    # Store the results\n",
    "    backtest_results.append({\n",
    "        'end_date': end_date,\n",
    "        'predicted_ice': predicted_ice,\n",
    "        'predicted_ice_weighted': predicted_ice_weighted,\n",
    "        'actual_ice': df.loc[end_date, 'ice'] if end_date in df.index else None\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Move the window forward by one month\n",
    "    end_date += pd.DateOffset(months=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert results to a DataFrame for analysis\n",
    "backtest_df = pd.DataFrame(backtest_results)\n",
    "backtest_df\n"
   ]
  }
